code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] != bg:
                pts.setdefault(grid[r][c], []).append((r, c))
    singles = [p[0] for color, p in pts.items() if len(p) == 1]
    anchor_row = singles[0][0] if len(singles) >= 2 and len({p[0] for p in singles}) == 1 else None
    for color, cells in pts.items():
        if len(cells) != 2:
            continue
        (r1,c1),(r2,c2) = sorted(cells)
        if abs(r2-r1) != abs(c2-c1) or r1 == r2:
            continue
        rowstep = 1 if anchor_row is None or (r1+r2)/2 > anchor_row else -1
        col_per_row = 1 if c2 > c1 else -1
        if (r2-r1) * rowstep > 0:
            y,x = r2,c2
        else:
            y,x = r1,c1
        dr,dc = rowstep, rowstep*col_per_row
        y,x = y+dr,x+dc
        while 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:
            if out[y][x] == bg:
                out[y][x] = color
            y,x = y+dr,x+dc
    return out
'''
